title: Bribery set size under a low mean
statement: Let $n\\ge 2$ and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be monotone. Suppose its mean is at least $-99/100$, and let $t\\in\\mathbb N$ satisfy $t\\le n$. If the function obtained after setting to $1$ all coordinates in the bribery set after $t$ steps has mean less than $99/100$, then that bribery set has cardinality exactly $t$.
hypotheses_covered: Mean after bribing the coordinates selected at step $t$ is less than $99/100$
